methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 12 dedicated rice cookers (micom, induction, electric pressure, and basic/digital types) spanning budget to premium tiers, from the high-search roster including Zojirushi, Tiger, Cuckoo, Aroma, Toshiba, Panasonic, COSORI, Yum Asia, and Dash. Specs verified primarily from official manufacturer product pages (store.zojirushi.com, cuckooamerica.com, cosori.com, bydash.com, tiger-corporation.com, yum-asia.com) and corroborated with major retail listings (Newegg, Walmart, Best Buy, Amazon, Opentip, Slickdeals) and independent review sites. Capacity values are uncooked cups using the manufacturer-standard rice measuring cup (180 ml) unless stated as cooked; type field uses 'micom' for microcomputer-controlled, 'induction' for IH-based, 'pressure' for electric pressure, and 'basic' for non-computerized models; boolean specs are true/false; menu_settings is the integer count of distinct cooking programs (using the retail-consensus marketed count where the official page conflates programs with functions/states); priceUsd reflects the verified US MSRP or current published price at time of research. accessedAt 2026-06-19. Adversarial re-verification corrected: Cuckoo CRP-P0609S menu count (14->12 marketed cooking programs); Zojirushi NL-AAC10 releaseDate (2024->null, model has shipped since ~2012-2013); COSORI CRC-R501-KUS releaseDate (2023->null, unverifiable); Panasonic SR-DF101 releaseDate (2012->null, unverifiable beyond ASIN heuristic); Yum Asia Sakura price set to official US store price and source URL repointed from EU to US page.
